title: Arm Wrestle Challenge
description: Verse a non player in an Arm Wrestle

title: Honk Hunt
description: Get any vehicle to honk their horn

title: Hickery Dickery Dock
description: Find the closest analogue clock and sing the nursery rhyme hickery dickery dock to claim your points; record video evidence

title: Business Card Blitz
description: Collect business cards from different locations or people. You have 5 minutes from now to find the first card. Every time you find another card
column3: the timer resets to 5 minutes. The challenge ends when your timer runs out. 1 Band per card. If you find no card
column4: the challenge is vetoed. Desperately needs play-testing^^^

title: Instant Veto 1
description: UH OH you are forced to wait 7 minutes

title: Muffin Man Response
description: As discreetly as you can but as loud as you can be
column3: call out Do you know the muffin man? First person to get a non player to respond with either Who lives on Drury Lane? or the muffin man?...YES THE MUFFIN MAN? completes this challenge

title: Loop de Loop
description: Complete loop de loop: catch any form of public transport to the first stop
column3: jump off and return to the challenge location via any means to collect your points

title: Photo Recreation
description: Find at least 2 teammates (3 people total) and recreate this photo. Each participating player receives a band

title: Leap Frog Relay
description: Find at least 2 teammates to play leap frog. Everyone must leap over each other at least twice. Provide video evidence. All participating players receive a band

title: Crab Walk to Bench
description: Crab walk to the nearest bench including crab hands. Provide video footage

title: Sale Outfit Runway
description: Find the nearest clothing store that is having a sale. You have 6 minutes from when you enter the store to put an outfit together and model it. You do not need to purchase it. Make a short video advertising your get up

title: Human Pyramid
description: Find at least 2 teammates and make a human pyramid. Each participant gets a band. Film your attempt

title: Dizzy Dash
description: Spin as fast as you can for 20 seconds
column3: then run to the nearest street pole that’s at least 10m away and back. Film your attempt from your POV

title: Wake Up Jeff
column4: or lying down). Only a teammate may physically touch you to wake you up. Each player gets a band

title: High-Five Statue
description: Pick a location and stand like a statue with your hand out waiting for a high-five. You may stand for up to 8 minutes or until someone high-fives you. You only get a band if someone high-fives you. No veto

title: Spelling Bee Shootout
description: Find 2 teammates for a Spelling Bee Shootout. Each teammate gets one attempt per word. You may Google a word if you don’t know it and use it in a sentence. Between the two of them they must correctly spell 3 of these 5 words: Accommodate
column7: all participating players get a band; if they fail

title: Rock Stack
description: You have 5 minutes starting now to create the highest single stack of rocks using rocks found nearby. You must stack at least 3 rocks. 1 band per every 3 rocks
